stimuli.description: 25 color photographs of natural scenes (lakes, rivers, sea, hills) rated high in restorativeness.
25 color photographs of urban scenes (city streets, industrial zones, housing) rated low in restorativeness.

tables.description: Mean d-primes, reaction times, numbers of correct and incorrect responses in Sessions 1 and 2 for restorative and nonrestorative groups (Experiment 1).
Mean d-primes, reaction times, and numbers of correct and incorrect responses in Sessions 1 and 2 for geometric patterns group (Experiment 2).
Mean d-primes, reaction times, and numbers of correct and incorrect responses in Sessions 1 and 2 for self-paced restorative and nonrestorative groups (Experiment 3).

limitations: Participants in this research did not have time enough to pass through all phases of restoration (clearing the head, recovering attention, facing accumulated matters, reflecting on priorities, prospects, actions, goals).
The study did not identify where participants were in the total restorative process.
